name: Recession
description: Falling output shrinks tax receipts and pushes layoffs through the economy.

name: Housing emergency
description: Unaffordable homes strain family budgets and public health.

name: Overloaded clinics
description: Long waits keep people out of work and erode faith in public services.

name: Power instability
description: Unreliable power slows businesses and makes streets less safe after dark.

name: Trust crisis
description: Allies hesitate to spend political capital on an administration the public doubts.

name: Inflation shock
description: Rising prices eat into wages and savings, hurting fixed-income households most.

name: Crime wave
description: Fear of crime drives people off main streets and dominates local news.

name: Civil-liberties backlash
description: Activists and courts push back against government overreach.

name: Debt warning
description: Lenders demand higher returns and fiscal conservatives lose patience.

name: Clean-energy transition
description: New clean-power industries hire workers while fossil-fuel regions feel the squeeze.

name: Broad job market
description: Plentiful jobs lift wages and confidence, but employers struggle to hire.
